title: Failure sites ignore taken_over_at: a failure on a taken-over row re-enters the correction loop and the follow-up correction dead-ends permanently (queued + taken_over_at, sweep-excluded forever, token cleared)
evidence:
mark_awaiting_correction.sql: `WHERE id = $1
  AND status IN ('queued', 'contact_initiated')` (no taken_over_at) — webhooks.gleam:322 `False -> case sql.mark_awaiting_correction(db, reference_call_id, terminal_reason)` fires on a taken-over row (takeover never changes status); correct_reference_call.sql: `WHERE id = $1
  AND application_id = $2
  AND status = 'awaiting_correction'::reference_call_status` + SET `form_token = NULL, form_token_expires_at = NULL` with NO taken_over_at clear; sweep_due_reference_calls.sql:59 `AND rc.taken_over_at IS NULL` then excludes the row forever.
detail: Takeover then late bounce/wrong-person: mark passes (row still queued/contact_initiated), landlord corrects, row re-queues with taken_over_at set; sweep never claims, old token dead, correct/take-over both 409 — no send, no terminal, no exit.
recommended_fix: Stand down delivery failures on taken-over rows (taken_over_at IS NULL in the mark/exhaust guards and the webhook genuine gate), or clear taken_over_at in correct_reference_call.sql so the re-queued correction re-enters the sweep.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 corrected_at gate compares mismatched formats — every SAME-DAY send lexically sorts after the correction ('T' vs ' '), so a stale pre-correction bounce on the correction day exhausts the row and fabricates referee_contact_invalid
detail: Stale redelivered pre-correction bounce arriving the same day as the correction (typical: bounce and fix within hours) exhausts the corrected row to unreachable and stamps a fabricated fraud signal — the exact r1 W3 defect.
recommended_fix: Compare parsed timestamps (or normalize both to one format, e.g. to_char(..., 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') in the SQL) before the lexical compare.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W4 cleared-channel rule not applied on the form-handler resend path — effective() falls back to the proven-dead snapshot address
detail: A corrected row whose email the landlord cleared is re-invited by the referee's own expired-link resend to the snapshot address that already failed (AD-7 never-re-contact violated on this path).
recommended_fix: Gate the resend's effective() on correction_cycles like the sweep helpers: corrected-only once a correction ran, so a cleared channel stays absent.

title: Substitute 'existing' branch returns ANY live non-terminal successor (skipped / awaiting_correction included) — a re-substitute of the history row with NEW trio details 200s and silently drops the new referee
evidence:
`SELECT rc.id::text, 'existing' AS how
FROM reference_call rc
WHERE rc.application_id = (SELECT application_id FROM guard LIMIT 1)
  AND rc.ref_slot = (SELECT ref_slot FROM guard LIMIT 1)
  AND rc.owner_label = (SELECT owner_label FROM guard LIMIT 1)
  AND rc.status NOT IN (
    'form_completed', 'unreachable', 'refused', 'objected',
    'manual_recorded', 'failed', 'completed', 'partial'
  )` — 'skipped' and 'awaiting_correction' are live-occupying, so they are returned as the 'existing successor'; actions_handler.gleam:349 `"existing" -> Ok(new_row.id)` returns 200 with no trio rewrite.
detail: Substitute, then skip (or the successor enters awaiting_correction), then re-substitute the retained history row with a different trio: 200 'substituted', new trio dropped, slot stays skipped/awaiting — no queued row ever invites the referee.
recommended_fix: Restrict the 'existing' branch to a sendable successor (status = 'queued'), else 409, so a substituted-but-not-queued slot never masquerades as a successful no-op.

title: Per-row ?slot= start re-arms ALL queued rows of the application — sibling slots jump their cadence (AC1 'other slots untouched' violated)
evidence:
trigger.gleam: `case sql.rearm_queued_reference_calls(config.db, app_uuid) {` — no slot parameter, runs after every start action including the `Some(slot)` filtered one; rearm_queued_reference_calls.sql: `WHERE application_id = $1
  AND status = 'queued'::reference_call_status
  AND taken_over_at IS NULL`.
detail: Starting one slot early nudges every other queued slot for the application to due-now; the sweep then invites a sibling referee days ahead of its scheduled T0. Mild, but contradicts AC1.
recommended_fix: Pass the requested slot into rearm (add a ref_slot filter, or rearm only when no slot filter was given).

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): N8 spec item 6 still omits corrected_name from the additive detail keys and item 5 says 'ONE additive column' while the migration adds corrected_name + corrected_at
evidence:
`5. **`supabase/migrations/`** (expand-only, ONE additive column): `corrected_name TEXT` — ...` and `6. **`shared/src/shared/reference_call.gleam`** — additive detail keys: `taken_over_at`,
   `contact_name`, `contact_email`, `contact_phone`, `corrected_email`, `corrected_phone`,
   `correction_cycles` (Option/Int, back-compat `optional_field` decoders). Encoder nullable.`
detail: The shipped code adds corrected_name to the payload and corrected_at to the migration; the spec's own contract enumeration contradicts both.
recommended_fix: Add corrected_name to item 6 and correct item 5 to 'two additive columns (corrected_name, corrected_at)'.
